title: The Planar Flat-Floor Sylvester Conjecture: Triangle Minimum and Square Counterexamples
description: Working paper resolving both proposed inequalities in Marckert–Morin arXiv:2411.08456v2, Conjecture 1.8. For every n≥3, a triangle with its full bottom side marked is the unique minimizer of the convex-position probability for n independent area-uniform points and the two floor endpoints. For each n≥3, a convex pentagonal perturbation of the square strictly exceeds the proposed square upper bound. The actual maximizing body is not identified. AI-assisted and internally reviewed, not externally peer reviewed.
